Sample.evidence_source: [/page/11/Text/4] Treatment effects were again analysed by means of two repeated measures of multivariate analyses of variance (MANOVA), conducted separately for two sets of variables, given the dependence between MESSY total scores and MESSY factor scores. The results of the repeated measures MANOVA for the CDI, LSSP, MESSY total and Teacher's MESSY total score indicated no statistically significant group or group by occasions effects. No dependent variable showed significant group or group by occasions effect on the univariate repeated measures analyses of variance. There was however, a significant time effect (Pillais F = 10-80, d.f. = 4-25, P < 0-001) indicating a tendency for subjects across all groups combined to change over time.
